item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las sbyin sreg me yi dbal 'khor
item.coloph: de ltar me yi las tshogs kyis/ byad ltas mi mthun zhi ba dang / mo rmi mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog lha srin za kha ma lus bsgyur/ mtha' 'khrugs bar chad rkyen rnams zhi/ dran pa nam mkhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// zhes pa sbin sreg 'di ni zab gter rin po che gsang sngags gling pas spyan drangs shing / phyis su mchog spral g.yung drung dang mkha' 'gro dbang mo sogs kyis bskul ngor dag pa phab ste/ yi ge pa ni mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'o//
